title: Simplify the hourglass icon using the Preview visual reference
outcome: Replace the detailed hourglass artwork with a simple abstract hourglass using broad shapes and restrained depth, with matching iOS light/dark and Watch variants.

included: Inspect Apple Preview as a visual style reference and create original abstract hourglass artwork with fewer forms and no fine physical-object detail.
Replace iPhone default and dark icons and the matching Watch icon while preserving native appearance registration.
Document prompts, reference, source validation and the separation from the previously archived build 6.
Coordinator-managed integration of the reviewed result, append-only evidence and task status; this contract revision adds the integration control scope before that phase.
excluded: Product behavior, signing, project structure, bundle identifiers and version/build allocation.
Physical-device actions, App Store operations and public support/privacy changes.
Reusing build 6 archive or CI evidence for the revised artwork.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Native catalogs consume matching 1024x1024 opaque RGB light/dark hourglass PNGs and a circle-safe Watch variant, with no behavior or identity changes.

Independent visual/source review confirms a bold simplified hourglass silhouette, coherent geometry across appearances, readable small-size rendering and accurate provenance and validation boundaries.
